description:
The file `/work/repos.txt` lists repository names, one per line. Ignore blank lines and whitespace around a name.

Look up the latest CI state of each repository with `ci_latest` (`svc.ciLatest` in TypeScript), one repository at a time, in file order. When a lookup fails with a transient error (`Timeout`, `Unavailable`, or `RateLimited`), retry it up to 3 more times, waiting 100 ms before the first retry, 200 ms before the second, and 400 ms before the third. Do not retry any other failure, and do not look a repository up again after a lookup succeeds.

Print one JSON object per line to standard output, one per repository in file order: `{"repo": NAME, "state": STATE}`, where `STATE` is the `state` the service reported, or `"missing"` when the lookup still failed. Exit with status 0.

Ci.doc: The combined CI state of a repository's newest commit, such as `passing` or `failing`.

capabilities.description: Reads the CI state of the newest commit on a repository's default branch.
